requirement_ref.quote: A shopper can filter the product list by category.

preconditions: the catalogue contains products in more than one category
test_objective: Filtering by Electronics narrows the product list to electronics only.

actions.instruction: narrow the catalogue to the Electronics category

target.description: narrow the catalogue to the Electronics category
target.name: Electronics

assertions.statement: Only products belonging to Electronics remain listed.

target.description: Only products belonging to Electronics remain listed.
target.name: Electronics

assertions.statement: The Electronics category is shown as the one currently applied.

target.description: The Electronics category is shown as the one currently applied.
target.name: Electronics

exceptions.summary: "Only products belonging to Electronics remain listed." was bound to a visible check on button "Electronics" (in main) — the closest thing available, not a faithful check.
